title: A conflict, in the road planners' words
heading: A Planner Message Names Rules and Projects, Never Rows
cases: each kind of row becomes its sentence, with the job's id and street
a district name may hold underscores, and the sentence writes them as spaces
a budget below ten thousand still gets a thousands separator
a row of an unknown kind still gets a sentence, never its raw name alone
a row that names a job, year or district the data lacks gets the fallback sentence
one crew is written in the singular
